cases.label: 실제 loopback HTTP로 목록·단건을 조회하고 아직 listen하지 않은 서버를 반환한다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const list=await request('/products');const item=await request('/products?id=p2');observe({before,list,item});}finally{await close();}

cases.label: 알 수 없는 자원과 잘못된 method를 404·405로 구분한다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const unknown=await request('/missing');const missing=await request('/products?id=p99');const method=await request('/products','POST','{}',{'content-type':'application/json'});observe({unknown,missing,method});}finally{await close();}

cases.label: 중복·미지 query와 불량 percent 인코딩을 정상 조회로 바꾸지 않는다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const results=[];for(const path of ['/products?id=p1&id=p2','/products?other=1','/products?id=','/products?id=%ZZ']){const value=await request(path);results.push({status:value.status,body:value.body});}observe(results);}finally{await close();}

cases.label: UTF-8 본문 바이트 상한을 적용한 뒤 다음 요청도 한 번씩 정상 처리한다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const body=JSON.stringify({id:'p1',note:'가'.repeat(12)});const large=await request('/lookup','POST',body,{'content-type':'application/json'});const next=await request('/products?id=p1');observe({characterCount:body.length,byteCount:Buffer.byteLength(body),large,next});}finally{await close();}

cases.label: 본문을 여러 조각으로 받고 중간 취소 뒤 서버가 새 요청을 처리한다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const chunked=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path:'/lookup',method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text)}));res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.write('{"id":');setTimeout(()=>req.end('"p2"}'),5);});let sawAbort=false;const serverAbort=new Promise(resolve=>server.once('request',incoming=>{incoming.once('aborted',()=>{sawAbort=true;resolve();});}));await new Promise(resolve=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path:'/lookup',method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},agent:false});req.on('error',()=>{});req.on('close',resolve);req.write('{"id":');setTimeout(()=>req.destroy(),15);});await serverAbort;const next=await request('/products');observe({chunked,sawAbort,next});}finally{await close();}

cases.label: 서버 close 완료를 기다리며 잘못된 본문 상한을 거부한다
cases.probe: const {once}=await import('node:events');const errors=[];for(const maxBodyBytes of [0,-1,1.5,'48',1048577]){try{const value=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes});value?.close();errors.push('returned');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}}const server=submission.createProductServer();server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));observe({errors,listening:server.listening,requestTimeout:server.requestTimeout,headersTimeout:server.headersTimeout});

cases.label: 불량 UTF-8 원시 바이트를 400으로 거부하고 정상 요청을 계속 처리한다
cases.probe: const http=await import('node:http');const {once}=await import('node:events');const server=submission.createProductServer({maxBodyBytes:48});const before=server.listening;server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const port=server.address().port;async function request(path,method='GET',body,headers={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.request({host:'127.0.0.1',port,path,method,headers,agent:false},res=>{let text='';res.setEncoding('utf8');res.on('data',chunk=>text+=chunk);res.on('end',()=>{try{resolve({status:res.statusCode,body:JSON.parse(text),type:res.headers['content-type'],allow:res.headers.allow??null});}catch(error){reject(error);}});res.on('error',reject);});req.on('error',reject);req.setTimeout(1500,()=>req.destroy(new Error('request timeout')));if(body!==undefined)req.write(body);req.end();});}async function close(){await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));} try{const invalid=[];for(const bytes of [[255],[195,40]]){const body=Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('{"id":"p1","note":"'),Buffer.from(bytes),Buffer.from('"}')]);const result=await request('/lookup','POST',body,{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8'});invalid.push({status:result.status,body:result.body});}const good=await request('/lookup','POST',JSON.stringify({id:'p2',note:'한글'}),{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8'});observe({invalid,next:{status:good.status,body:good.body}});}finally{await close();}
